Version 1.0.0 of ucts-retro

- Initial release with a structured weekly engineering retrospective format.
- Guides users through "What Shipped," "What Broke," "What to Improve," and "Action Items" sections.
- Provides concrete prompts for each section to encourage actionable insights.
- Limits action items to three, with requirements for owner, deadline, and clear definition of done.
- Integrates with OpenClaw and includes instructions for spawning a Claude Code session if needed.
